explanation: The English article says the election was held to elect a successor to the incumbent President Jorge Sampaio, "who was barred from running for a third consecutive term by the Constitution of Portugal", and its background repeats it: re-elected in the first round in 2001, "because he was term-limited, he was forbidden by the Constitution to run for a third consecutive term". The two-term limit is why the sitting president was not a candidate; who replaced him is the record's own.
